name: udx_wpa_ew_a0
scheme_description: The ew-gmu scheme on the loop_qcd_qed_sm_Gmu restriction a0 (restrict_a0.dat: aEW0M1 = 137.035999 kept). No coupling or counterterm parameter of the G_mu UFO uses aEW0, so MadLoop's raw values equal ew-gmu's; aEW0M1 enters only MG5's alpha(0) formula for tagged photons, which MadLoop standalone does not apply.
scope: Independent provider references at exact on-shell decimal points; MadLoop in quadruple precision at every point (return codes 328); timings are single-run by-products, not benchmarks.
convention: MadLoop/BLHA C_eps=(4pi)^eps/Gamma(1-eps); F_MadLoop=F_Recola+pi^2/6*D; OpenLoops truepoles=1, polenorm=0; physical couplings, no alpha extraction; initial spin/colour average and final identical-particle factor included

point_construction.construction: tools/loop_reference/supplied_points.py: deterministic sequential construction at 60 digits, printed on a common quantum of 30 significant digits of sqrt(s); momentum conservation exact in the printed decimals (the last final particle takes the rounding residual), mass shells to the recorded defects

cuts.resonance_exclusion: |s_ij-M^2| >= M^2/10 for final particle-antiparticle pairs (regular family)

point_construction.madloop_qp_point: each point is MadLoop's quadruple-precision point of its binary64 rounding (ImprovePSPoint=2, ORIG method of improve_ps.f, replicated at the construction precision)

error_metric: |a-b|/max(|a|,|b|,|Born|*coupling/(2pi)) for Laurent coefficients, |a-b|/max(|a|,|b|) for Born; strict relative errors also listed per row

madloop.timing_scope: single thread pinned; point 1 evaluated once untimed for initialization, then each point timed once (points 2..n,1); includes all actual poles; not a benchmark campaign

fortran_flags.source: MG5_aMC run-card defaults global_flag/aloha_flag/matrix_flag (CommonRunCmd.update_make_opts of an optimised MG5 run); MadLoop's own makefile adds -O3 for polynomial.f

mg5_quadruple_precision_model_function_r: added KIND=16 to 19 CMPLX calls in MP_ functions
settings.quadruple_precision_stage: every point: the run's loop_matrix.f copy bypasses MadLoop's double-precision acceptance, so its quadruple-precision stage (MLStabThres test over two propagator directions; Ninja, else CutTools) evaluates every point (references.force_quadruple_stage)

split_points.note: one job per point: every point is also the job's initialisation point; process_wall_seconds is the sum over the jobs, initial_call_seconds the first job's (all jobs listed here)

tolerance_scope: 'tolerance' and 'validation_status' are the references.py merge's provider-agreement check (the G1 2e-8 tolerance); they are not M-SM acceptance values: m-sm/PLAN.md §1.4 applies, with each point's 'reference' record

madloop_r2_couplings.source: MG5_aMC regeneration of the export's amplitudes with its own settings (madloop_ct_couplings.py): UFO couplings of the R2 vertices attached to the loops; called_as = the merged name its call passes (P0_udx_wpa)
